files.SKILL.md:
---
name: review
description: Review a CentDeck project before delivery
---
Use project_context and plugin_official_inspector_summary to count pages, open marks and locks. Read each changed page, check mobile layout in the browser with ui_action. Report actual evidence; do not equate a successful file save with visual acceptance. Never clear marks or locks to make a report appear complete.
